title: Evaluation Framework for Understanding Sensitive Attribute Association Bias in Latent Factor Recommendation Algorithms

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating attribute bias directions in latent embedding spaces using centroid difference, support vector classifiers (SVC), and principal component analysis (PCA). The paper also applies entity attribute association metrics (EAA, GEAA, DEAA, and R-RIPA) and trains downstream classification models to measure the semantic entanglement between user gender and recommended item genres (specifically podcasts).
